description: Issue #196, profile-contract.md §10.2: a count of 0 is refused. Zero is the value that reads as "no limit" to a human and means "time out immediately" to `commandmate wait`, so accepting it would turn a declaration written to STOP timeouts into one that guarantees them. The bound is >= 1 and it is checked where the profile is read, not where the value is used. `load_error` / exit 6.

error_details_include: profile.dispatch_defaults.wait_timeout must be a positive integer, got 0
